title: Which bow grip looks more natural: left or right?
author: rectangle_so
selftext:
Getting the hand to hold onto the bow took WAAAAY LONGER than it needed to be… I’ll show some of the bloopers below lol.

BUT I think it looks way better than it started.

Which one looks more natural to you the left or the right? I’m mainly trying to figure out which version does a better job of showing the separation between the hand and the arm.

comments.author: EchoingAngel
comments.body: This feels like overthinking, but right

replies.author: rectangle_so
replies.body: i was thinking the same thing & yes i am an over thinker 😂

replies.author: rectangle_so
replies.body: feels like a game of wheres waldo eh LOL, its on the hand. left is red, right is black

comments.author: 12redandblack12
comments.body: i prefer left, the right looks a bit too severe, and zoomed out draws the eye too much towards the hand where the black becomes too diminant. the lighter pixels still make the separation clear and it works cohesively.

replies.author: rectangle_so
replies.body: you might be onto something... i was originally thinking right but now it also feels like it blends in with the bow.

replies.author: rectangle_so
replies.body: LOOL this is what i needed!

comments.author: modfreq
comments.body:
Honestly neither looks natural at all because of the way the bowstring goes over the shoulder.

I'd try to make the bow less curved and get the bowstring under the shoulder.

replies.author: rectangle_so
replies.body: thats honestly the problem, i dont really have much wiggle room given the dimensions of my characters. it's good for now, i can always come back to it later

comments.author: Initial-Theme-462
comments.body: I’m going to be honest, I looked at these for about five minutes without being able to spot the difference. So, probably either will work just fine. With that said, once I noticed the difference, I preferred the left.

replies.author: -svde-
replies.body: omg it’s the fucking wrist. one line is a different color. i thought i was crazy.

comments.author: EntryRadar
comments.body: jesus christ they look exactly the same, you’ll never finish a project if you’re splitting hairs like this.

replies.author: rectangle_so
replies.body: i've launched many projects my friend, but i appreciate the feedback traveller

comments.author: mfb1274
comments.body: Can you even tell me the difference?

replies.author: rectangle_so
replies.body: the devil lives in the detail my friend

comments.author: Grand_Sprinkles_2094
comments.body: Use it on a crt to decide

comments.author: Livid_Shallot5701
comments.body: definitely the right one with black
